behavior: An active `NavigationMenu.Trigger` follows each change of the `id` of `NavigationMenu.Popup` in its `aria-controls`, and of the `id` of `NavigationMenu.Viewport` in the `aria-owns` of the owner element after it. An element with an empty `id` gives no attribute. Base UI reads the `id` of the element when the trigger renders, so after a change of the `id` the trigger names the old id until it renders again. No element has that id.
